title: AI in Search Reduces Publisher Referrals Without Improving User Experience: Experimental Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.18352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The integration of generative AI into web search delivers synthesized answers to user queries, changing how people navigate and assess information, while raising concerns about the downstream impacts on publishers who supply the underlying content. We conduct a preregistered field experiment (N=1,100) on Google Search, the dominant online search platform, to estimate the causal effects of AI Overviews and AI Mode on user behavior, perceptions, and publisher traffic. We show that removing AI Overviews and AI Mode increases click-through rates to publishers, while an AI Mode-only experience reduces click-through rates and erodes user experience and trust in information found on Google. These findings show that integrating generative AI into web search reshapes online attention, with economic consequences for the online publishers that sustain both search platforms and the overall information ecosystem.

translated_title: 搜索中的AI减少出版商引荐流量且未改善用户体验：实验证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18352v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将生成式AI整合到网络搜索中，为用户查询提供综合答案，改变了人们导航和评估信息的方式，同时引发了对提供底层内容的出版商下游影响的担忧。我们在主导在线搜索平台谷歌搜索上进行了一项预注册的现场实验（N=1,100），以估计AI概览和AI模式对用户行为、感知和出版商流量的因果效应。我们表明，移除AI概览和AI模式会增加对出版商的点击率，而仅使用AI模式的体验会降低点击率，并削弱用户体验和对在谷歌上找到的信息的信任。这些发现表明，将生成式AI整合到网络搜索中重塑了在线注意力，对支撑搜索平台和整体信息生态系统的在线出版商具有经济后果。
tldr: 本研究通过现场实验证明，谷歌搜索中的生成式AI功能（如AI概览和AI模式）会减少用户对出版商的点击流量，且未改善用户体验，反而可能损害用户信任，对依赖搜索流量的在线出版商构成经济威胁。
en_tdlr: This study, via a field experiment, shows that generative AI features (like AI Overviews and AI Mode) in Google Search reduce click-through rates to publishers without improving user experience, potentially eroding trust and posing economic threats to online publishers sustaining the search ecosystem.
